evidence.source_statement: Do not fabricate, infer, or substitute an unverified filesystem path for a project when writing or running a YAML-specified job against a local Git repository.
source_conditions: Job targets an existing explicitly authorized local repository.
source_exceptions: Does not authorize changing unrelated or substitute repositories.
